title: Listening Drill — Map-reading workshop — Guided practice
description: Practical demonstration. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Map-reading workshop — Guided practice
sections.transcript:
TUTOR: Before our demonstration on map-reading workshop, let me explain what you need and what to record. Collect your materials from the meeting hut before the demonstration begins. Inside the handout you will find a blank marked map to fill in.

TUTOR: Watch the demonstration once before you try it. Before you begin, check for the fault that affected the previous group: faded print. If you notice it, let me know instead of making an adjustment yourself.

TUTOR: Now work in pairs. After the first attempt, check map orientation and write the result down immediately. You then have fifteen minutes to compare your result with your partner’s. You can disagree, but both partners should keep a note of what they observed.

TUTOR: On your way out, take anything you borrowed back to the stone arch. Please leave your notes in the folder so we can discuss them next time.
